items.title: FAA Advances American Drone Dominance with First of its Kind Authorization for Long-Range Drone Operations over Gulf of America
items.summary: WASHINGTON – The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) today announced it issued the first of its kind authorization for a drone to fly beyond the operator’s visual line of sight from the U.S. coastline over the Gulf of America, marking a significant milestone in advancing American drone dominance and expanding the future of uncrewed aviation.
